description: The file defines a JavaScript module that adds a custom button to the ERPNext UI form for sales invoices, enabling the generation of electronic invoices (E-Invoices) specific to the Italian regional compliance within the ERPNext framework.

methods.name: erpnext.setup_e_invoice_button
methods.description: Initializes and attaches a 'Generate E-Invoice' button to the specified doctype form; when clicked, it triggers the generation of an Italian E-Invoice via a server method, reloads the document, and opens a URL to download the invoice.
